scoring_justification: The paper's claim is a qualitative trend of growth rate ordering across facets at high temperature and shape preservation at low temperature, not a precise numeric value; therefore a structural check on the output CSV is the strongest feasible tier.

outputs.description: Effective growth rate distribution used to assess temperature-dependent growth mode: high temperature shows facet-dependent rate ordering, low temperature shows shape-preserving growth.

output_contract.notes: The checker will verify that the effective growth rate profiles match the qualitative behavior described in the paper: at 850 K the mean growth rate on the flat terrace is distinctly different from and opposite in sign to that on the diagonal facet, with the sign depending on the parameter set; at 700 K the profile is nearly uniform across the surface. No exact numerical targets are required.

steps.description: Checks structural trend: ordering at 850 K for each parameter set and shape-preserving at 700 K.
